free_tier_limits: 2-week free trial: 60 hits/min. Afterward, non-paid access: 5 hits/min. Trial/free-restricted level of detail is capped at Medium (0); endpoint travel-time caps range from 2 to 12 hours.
rate_limits: 60 hits/min during the 2-week trial; 5 hits/min afterward. One hit is one isochrone, route, or matrix search. Paid licences have custom or no concurrency limits.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: original "unknown" is incorrect; official 2026 docs publish the trial, post-trial, travel-time, and level-of-detail limits: https://docs.traveltime.com/api/overview/usage-limits. rate_limits: original "not published" is incorrect; the same official page specifies 60 hits/min during trial, 5 afterward, and custom or no limits for paid licences.
